method: scripts/ib-research/claim-check.js: the passage is copied verbatim from the live source text at the pinned revision; VERIFIED = every claim number in one sentence that shares >= 50% of the claim's content words

records.claim: In 2013, the concept was published by businessman Elon Musk in a white paper, where the hyperloop was described as a transportation system using capsules within a low-pressure tube.
records.passage: In 2013, the concept was published by businessman Elon Musk in a white paper, where the hyperloop was described as a transportation system using capsules supported by an air-bearing surface within a low-pressure tube.

records.passage: Virgin Hyperloop conducted the first human trial in November 2020 at its test site in Las Vegas, reaching a top speed of 172 km/h (107 mph).

narration.text: Why hyperloop's first riders only hit 172 km/h.
Elon Musk published the idea in 2013.
Pods were meant to race through near-vacuum tubes.
A student pod hit 463 kilometres per hour in 2019.
The first human ride came in 2020, at a Las Vegas test track.
Keeping hundreds of kilometres of tube airtight is the hard part.
Europe released a draft hyperloop standard in 2023.
So the physics is simple. The engineering is not.
